items_flat.title_en: Google Cloud launches the Gemini agent as a universal agent for work
items_flat.title_zh: Google Cloud 推出 Gemini agent，定位為工作用通用代理
items_flat.summary_en: At Gemini at Work 2026 on Oct 8, Google Cloud announced the Gemini agent, a single prompt-window agent for questions, knowledge work, media, and code. Google said it plans the work, picks a model, uses skills and tools, and connects to customer systems, with enterprise cost and admin controls. A companion post said it can orchestrate Gemini models and Claude today, with other private and open models later.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Gemini at Work 2026，Google Cloud 宣布 Gemini agent：單一提示視窗處理問答、知識工作、媒體與程式。官方說它會規劃工作、選擇模型、使用技能與工具，並連到客戶既有系統，附企業成本與管理控制。配套文章稱目前可編排 Gemini 與 Claude，之後再接其他私有與開源模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product-layer bet that routing, memory, and enterprise controls matter more than any one model. Availability and which systems are live at launch remain open: the official posts describe the agent, not a completed public rollout metric.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產品層押注：路由、記憶與企業控制比單一模型更關鍵。上線範圍與哪些系統已實際接通仍未交代，官方描述的是代理能力，不是完成度數字。
items_flat.quote: Today at Gemini at Work 2026, Google Cloud announced the Gemini agent, a universal agent for work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天在 Gemini at Work 2026，Google Cloud 宣布 Gemini agent，一個用於工作的通用代理。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic commits $150 million over three years to the US Genesis Mission
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 三年承諾 1.5 億美元支持美國 Genesis Mission
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct 8 Anthropic said it will commit $150 million over three years to the federal Genesis Mission, extending a Department of Energy partnership first announced last December. The company said the funding will help make Claude, Claude Code, and API credits available to more than 15 agencies, including NASA, NIH, and NSF, and to several hundred research projects, with fusion and quantum among named priorities.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Anthropic 表示，將在三年內投入 1.5 億美元支持聯邦 Genesis Mission，延續去年 12 月與能源部的合作。資金用於讓 Claude、Claude Code 與 API 額度覆蓋超過 15 個機構（含 NASA、NIH、NSF）及數百個研究計畫，點名優先項目包括核融合與量子運算。
items_flat.analysis_en: This ties Claude distribution to a named federal science program rather than a new model. What remains unclear is how the $150 million is split between credits, services, and cash, and what access restrictions apply inside the labs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是把 Claude 的供給綁到具名聯邦科學計畫，不是新模型。1.5 億美元如何拆成額度、服務與現金，以及實驗室內存取限制，官方都還沒說清。
items_flat.quote: Anthropic is deepening its support for American scientific research by committing $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission.
items_flat.quote_zh: Anthropic 正加深對美國科學研究的支持，承諾在三年內向 Genesis Mission 投入 1.5 億美元。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Intelligent UI rollout was set to reach Free and Go on Oct 8
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Intelligent UI 預定 10 月 8 日起覆蓋 Free 與 Go
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s Oct 7 announcement says GPT-6 with Intelligent UI began rolling out globally that day for Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise in the Chat tab, and would expand to Free and Go starting Oct 8. Paid tiers use GPT-6 Sol; Free and Go use GPT-6 Luna. The product can mix text, visuals, and in-chat tools, and start answering while it continues to think.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10 月 7 日公告稱，GPT-6 搭配 Intelligent UI 當日已對 Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 的 Chat 分頁全球推出，並自 10 月 8 日起擴至 Free 與 Go。付費層用 GPT-6 Sol，Free 與 Go 用 GPT-6 Luna。它可混用文字、視覺與對話內工具，並在繼續思考時先開始回答。
items_flat.analysis_en: The product change is distribution and interface, not a new model family. Until OpenAI publishes completion numbers, treat the Free and Go leg as a scheduled rollout rather than a confirmed finish.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 變化在發行範圍與介面，不是新模型家族。在 OpenAI 公布完成率之前，Free 與 Go 這一腿應視為排程推出，而非已確認完成。
items_flat.quote: Starting tomorrow, the rollout expands to Free and Go tiers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 從明天起，推出範圍將擴至 Free 與 Go 層級。

items_flat.title_en: Reports: OpenAI told investors September annualized revenue was near $50 billion
items_flat.title_zh: 報導：OpenAI 向投資人稱 9 月年化營收接近 500 億美元
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct 8 Reuters, citing a person familiar and an earlier Financial Times report, said OpenAI told investors its September annualized revenue was almost $50 billion, below a roughly $70 billion run rate previously reported. The source said the gap came from attempts to compare OpenAI with Anthropic: unlike Anthropic, OpenAI does not count cloud-partner sales such as AWS and Google Cloud. OpenAI did not comment to Reuters.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日路透引述知情人士與先前《金融時報》報導，稱 OpenAI 向投資人表示 9 月年化營收近 500 億美元，低於稍早傳出的約 700 億美元運行率。消息人士說落差來自與 Anthropic 的比較方式：OpenAI 不像 Anthropic 那樣計入 AWS、Google Cloud 等雲端夥伴銷售。OpenAI 未回覆路透置評。
items_flat.analysis_en: The figure is investor communication reported by press, not an OpenAI filing. The useful change is the accounting gap with Anthropic, which makes headline run-rate comparisons unstable until both labs use the same perimeter.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是媒體轉述的投資人溝通，不是 OpenAI 正式申報。真正改變的是與 Anthropic 的口徑差異，在兩邊用同一邊界前，年化營收標題比較並不穩。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches a Cyber Mission for critical infrastructure and open source
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 Cyber Mission，涵蓋關鍵基礎設施與開源軟體
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct 8 Anthropic launched the Anthropic Cyber Mission, starting with a Critical Infrastructure Defense Program and a free opt-in OSS Scanner. CIDP brings frontier Claude models, on-site engineers, and threat research to founding partners that support power, water, transport, and government systems. OSS Scanner sends opted-in projects model-generated reports with a proof-of-concept, explanation, and suggested fix, without human review.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Anthropic 啟動 Cyber Mission，先做關鍵基礎設施防禦計畫（CIDP）與免費、須選擇加入的 OSS Scanner。CIDP 把前沿 Claude、駐點工程師與威脅研究帶給支援電力、水務、交通與政府系統的夥伴。OSS Scanner 對加入的專案送出模型生成報告，含概念驗證、說明與建議修補，且不經人工複核。
items_flat.analysis_en: The notable shift is moving from private scanning under Project Glasswing to an opt-in service that ships unreviewed model reports. The risk is maintainer overload if the promised volume arrives before triage quality is proven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 關鍵轉變是從 Project Glasswing 的內部掃描，變成會直接送出未經人工複核報告的選擇加入服務。若量先到、分流品質未驗證，維護者負擔是主要風險。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re launching the Anthropic Cyber Mission, a long-term commitment to securing the systems everyone depends on.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們啟動 Anthropic Cyber Mission，這是一項確保眾人仰賴之系統安全的長期承諾。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic researcher uses Claude Science to fill the first complete UV sky map
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 研究員用 Claude Science 補出首張完整紫外天圖
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct 8 Anthropic published a science post by Johns Hopkins astrophysicist and Anthropic researcher Brice Ménard. He said Claude Science gathered existing UV datasets, merged them, and predicted the unobserved third of the sky, including much of the galactic plane, in a few days of work that he said would have taken weeks. The map labels pixels as measured or predicted and includes uncertainty layers.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Anthropic 刊出約翰霍普金斯天體物理學家、亦為 Anthropic 研究員的 Brice Ménard 文章。他說 Claude Science 彙整既有紫外資料、合併後，用數天補出約三分之一從未觀測的天空（含銀河盤面大部分），這類工作他認為人工要數週。成圖會標示實測或預測，並附不確定性圖層。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a case study of an existing tool, not a new model. About a third of the map is inferred, so its scientific value depends on the published uncertainty layers, not on the claim of a first complete map alone.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有工具的案例，不是新模型。約三分之一是推論，科學價值取決於公開的不確定性圖層，而不只是「第一張完整圖」的說法。
items_flat.quote: About a third of this map, including much of the galactic plane, was predicted with Claude Science.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這張圖約三分之一，包括銀河盤面的大部分，是用 Claude Science 預測出來的。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI rolls out Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 Ultrafast 模式
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct 8 OpenAI said Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol was rolling out in the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work. The developer post describes it as near-Astra intelligence at up to 8x the speed of Sol Standard, priced at $12 per million input tokens and $60 per million output tokens. API access is global with US and EU data residency; Codex and Work access is limited to Pro 500, eligible Enterprise, and credit-based Edu, and Enterprise admins must enable it.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 OpenAI 表示 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 Ultrafast 模式已在 API、Codex 與 ChatGPT Work 推出。開發者貼文稱其接近 Astra 智能、速度最高可達 Sol Standard 的 8 倍，定價為每百萬輸入 12 美元、每百萬輸出 60 美元。API 全球可用並支援美歐資料落地；Codex 與 Work 限 Pro 500、符合資格的 Enterprise 與學分制 Edu，且 Enterprise 管理員須開啟。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a serving-tier change on an existing model, not a new release. The speed claim is OpenAI’s own; independent latency comparisons were not in the announcement.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有模型的服務層級調整，不是新發布。速度說法來自 OpenAI 自身，公告沒有獨立延遲對照。
items_flat.quote: Near-Astra intelligence at up to 8x faster speeds than Sol Standard, so you can build as fast as the ideas come.
items_flat.quote_zh: 接近 Astra 的智能，速度最高可比 Sol Standard 快 8 倍，讓你能跟得上想法的速度來打造。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI says it banned Russian and Iranian “false front” influence operations
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 稱已封禁俄羅斯與伊朗的「假門面」影響行動
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct 8 OpenAI said it banned two influence operations, one originating in Russia and one in Iran, that used its models alongside conventional techniques to support “false front” entities laundering geopolitical messaging. OpenAI described an Iranian set of seven journalist personas pitching outlets, and a Russian cluster it said co-opted unwitting people in Latin America. It rated the Russia-origin operation Category 5 on the IO Breakout Scale, its first such rating.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 OpenAI 表示已封禁兩起影響行動，分別源自俄羅斯與伊朗，行為者把模型與傳統手法併用，支撐用來清洗地緣政治訊息的「假門面」實體。伊朗一侧被描述為七個記者Persona向媒體投稿；俄羅斯集群據稱拉攏拉丁美洲不知情人士。OpenAI 把俄方行動評為 IO Breakout Scale 第 5 類，稱是其首次給出該等級。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post is a threat report, not evidence that model access was the decisive capability. Category 5 is OpenAI’s own scale rating; reach and downstream publication were not independently measured in the post.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是威脅報告，不能直接證明模型存取是決定性能力。第 5 類是 OpenAI 自己的量表；貼文沒有獨立測量觸及或下游刊出量。
items_flat.quote: We recently banned two IO—one from Russia and one from Iran—that used our models in combination with more traditional techniques.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們最近封禁了兩起影響行動——一起來自俄羅斯、一起來自伊朗——它們把我們的模型與較傳統的技術併用。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes a 2026 usage-policy update effective Nov 12
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 公布 2026 使用政策更新，11 月 12 日生效
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct 8 Anthropic published a Usage Policy update that takes effect Nov 12. It consolidates bans on deceptive campaigns and fake-account amplification, narrows the elections section to voter deception and disruption, and clarifies rules for health, finance, and models connected to hardware that can take autonomous physical actions. Anthropic said most changes clarify existing rules as Claude takes on longer independent work.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Anthropic 公布使用政策更新，11 月 12 日生效。內容整合對欺騙性宣傳與假帳號放大的禁止、把選舉條款收窄到選民欺騙與干擾，並釐清健康、金融，以及模型連接可自主採取物理行動之硬體時的規則。Anthropic 稱多數變更是在 Claude 承擔更長獨立工作後，釐清既有規則。
items_flat.analysis_en: Most of the post is clarification of existing enforcement, not a new capability cutoff. The hardware clause is the part most likely to matter for agents, because Anthropic now states requirements when models are connected to systems that can cause injury.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 多數內容是釐清既有執法，不是新的能力切斷。硬體條款對代理最可能有影響，因為 Anthropic 現在明訂模型接到可能造成傷害的系統時的要求。
items_flat.quote: The updated policy takes effect on November 12.
items_flat.quote_zh: 更新後的政策於 11 月 12 日生效。

items_flat.title_en: Claude Dashboards and Motion enter beta; Docs, Slides, and Design go GA
items_flat.title_zh: Claude Dashboards 與 Motion 進入測試；Docs、Slides、Design 正式推出
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct 8 Anthropic said Claude can turn connected company data into a live dashboard and ideas into editable animated explainers. Dashboards is in beta on paid plans and connects to platforms such as BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, and Salesforce; Motion is also beta. Docs, Slides, and Design moved to general availability. No new primary post in the last 12 hours changed this status.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Anthropic 表示 Claude 可把已連接的公司資料做成即時儀表板，並把想法做成可編輯的動畫說明。Dashboards 在付費方案測試，可接 BigQuery、Databricks、Snowflake、Salesforce 等；Motion 亦為測試。Docs、Slides、Design 轉為正式提供。過去 12 小時沒有新的主要公告改變此狀態。
items_flat.analysis_en: This extends Claude into BI and presentation tools, but both new features are still beta and plan-gated. Showing the query behind each chart is the practical control; Motion’s code-level editability is the open question for production use.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這把 Claude 延伸到 BI 與簡報工具，但兩項新功能仍是測試且受方案限制。圖表背後可看查詢是實際控制點；Motion 能否在程式層級穩定編輯，仍是正式使用的未決問題。
items_flat.quote: Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are now in beta. Docs, Slides, and Design are out of beta and on every Claude plan, including Free.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Dashboards 與 Claude Motion 現已進入測試。Docs、Slides 與 Design 已結束測試，並在包含 Free 的所有 Claude 方案提供。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic commits $150 million over three years to the US Genesis Mission
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 三年承諾 1.5 億美元支持美國 Genesis Mission
anthropic.summary_en: On Oct 8 Anthropic said it will commit $150 million over three years to the federal Genesis Mission, extending a Department of Energy partnership first announced last December. The company said the funding will help make Claude, Claude Code, and API credits available to more than 15 agencies, including NASA, NIH, and NSF, and to several hundred research projects, with fusion and quantum among named priorities.
anthropic.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Anthropic 表示，將在三年內投入 1.5 億美元支持聯邦 Genesis Mission，延續去年 12 月與能源部的合作。資金用於讓 Claude、Claude Code 與 API 額度覆蓋超過 15 個機構（含 NASA、NIH、NSF）及數百個研究計畫，點名優先項目包括核融合與量子運算。
anthropic.analysis_en: This ties Claude distribution to a named federal science program rather than a new model. What remains unclear is how the $150 million is split between credits, services, and cash, and what access restrictions apply inside the labs.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是把 Claude 的供給綁到具名聯邦科學計畫，不是新模型。1.5 億美元如何拆成額度、服務與現金，以及實驗室內存取限制，官方都還沒說清。
anthropic.quote: Anthropic is deepening its support for American scientific research by committing $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission.
anthropic.quote_zh: Anthropic 正加深對美國科學研究的支持，承諾在三年內向 Genesis Mission 投入 1.5 億美元。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic launches a Cyber Mission for critical infrastructure and open source
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 Cyber Mission，涵蓋關鍵基礎設施與開源軟體
anthropic.summary_en: On Oct 8 Anthropic launched the Anthropic Cyber Mission, starting with a Critical Infrastructure Defense Program and a free opt-in OSS Scanner. CIDP brings frontier Claude models, on-site engineers, and threat research to founding partners that support power, water, transport, and government systems. OSS Scanner sends opted-in projects model-generated reports with a proof-of-concept, explanation, and suggested fix, without human review.
anthropic.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Anthropic 啟動 Cyber Mission，先做關鍵基礎設施防禦計畫（CIDP）與免費、須選擇加入的 OSS Scanner。CIDP 把前沿 Claude、駐點工程師與威脅研究帶給支援電力、水務、交通與政府系統的夥伴。OSS Scanner 對加入的專案送出模型生成報告，含概念驗證、說明與建議修補，且不經人工複核。
anthropic.analysis_en: The notable shift is moving from private scanning under Project Glasswing to an opt-in service that ships unreviewed model reports. The risk is maintainer overload if the promised volume arrives before triage quality is proven.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 關鍵轉變是從 Project Glasswing 的內部掃描，變成會直接送出未經人工複核報告的選擇加入服務。若量先到、分流品質未驗證，維護者負擔是主要風險。
anthropic.quote: Today we’re launching the Anthropic Cyber Mission, a long-term commitment to securing the systems everyone depends on.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天我們啟動 Anthropic Cyber Mission，這是一項確保眾人仰賴之系統安全的長期承諾。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic researcher uses Claude Science to fill the first complete UV sky map
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 研究員用 Claude Science 補出首張完整紫外天圖
anthropic.summary_en: On Oct 8 Anthropic published a science post by Johns Hopkins astrophysicist and Anthropic researcher Brice Ménard. He said Claude Science gathered existing UV datasets, merged them, and predicted the unobserved third of the sky, including much of the galactic plane, in a few days of work that he said would have taken weeks. The map labels pixels as measured or predicted and includes uncertainty layers.
anthropic.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Anthropic 刊出約翰霍普金斯天體物理學家、亦為 Anthropic 研究員的 Brice Ménard 文章。他說 Claude Science 彙整既有紫外資料、合併後，用數天補出約三分之一從未觀測的天空（含銀河盤面大部分），這類工作他認為人工要數週。成圖會標示實測或預測，並附不確定性圖層。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is a case study of an existing tool, not a new model. About a third of the map is inferred, so its scientific value depends on the published uncertainty layers, not on the claim of a first complete map alone.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是既有工具的案例，不是新模型。約三分之一是推論，科學價值取決於公開的不確定性圖層，而不只是「第一張完整圖」的說法。
anthropic.quote: About a third of this map, including much of the galactic plane, was predicted with Claude Science.
anthropic.quote_zh: 這張圖約三分之一，包括銀河盤面的大部分，是用 Claude Science 預測出來的。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic publishes a 2026 usage-policy update effective Nov 12
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 公布 2026 使用政策更新，11 月 12 日生效
anthropic.summary_en: On Oct 8 Anthropic published a Usage Policy update that takes effect Nov 12. It consolidates bans on deceptive campaigns and fake-account amplification, narrows the elections section to voter deception and disruption, and clarifies rules for health, finance, and models connected to hardware that can take autonomous physical actions. Anthropic said most changes clarify existing rules as Claude takes on longer independent work.
anthropic.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Anthropic 公布使用政策更新，11 月 12 日生效。內容整合對欺騙性宣傳與假帳號放大的禁止、把選舉條款收窄到選民欺騙與干擾，並釐清健康、金融，以及模型連接可自主採取物理行動之硬體時的規則。Anthropic 稱多數變更是在 Claude 承擔更長獨立工作後，釐清既有規則。
anthropic.analysis_en: Most of the post is clarification of existing enforcement, not a new capability cutoff. The hardware clause is the part most likely to matter for agents, because Anthropic now states requirements when models are connected to systems that can cause injury.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 多數內容是釐清既有執法，不是新的能力切斷。硬體條款對代理最可能有影響，因為 Anthropic 現在明訂模型接到可能造成傷害的系統時的要求。
anthropic.quote: The updated policy takes effect on November 12.
anthropic.quote_zh: 更新後的政策於 11 月 12 日生效。

anthropic.title_en: Claude Dashboards and Motion enter beta; Docs, Slides, and Design go GA
anthropic.title_zh: Claude Dashboards 與 Motion 進入測試；Docs、Slides、Design 正式推出
anthropic.summary_en: On Oct 8 Anthropic said Claude can turn connected company data into a live dashboard and ideas into editable animated explainers. Dashboards is in beta on paid plans and connects to platforms such as BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, and Salesforce; Motion is also beta. Docs, Slides, and Design moved to general availability. No new primary post in the last 12 hours changed this status.
anthropic.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Anthropic 表示 Claude 可把已連接的公司資料做成即時儀表板，並把想法做成可編輯的動畫說明。Dashboards 在付費方案測試，可接 BigQuery、Databricks、Snowflake、Salesforce 等；Motion 亦為測試。Docs、Slides、Design 轉為正式提供。過去 12 小時沒有新的主要公告改變此狀態。
anthropic.analysis_en: This extends Claude into BI and presentation tools, but both new features are still beta and plan-gated. Showing the query behind each chart is the practical control; Motion’s code-level editability is the open question for production use.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這把 Claude 延伸到 BI 與簡報工具，但兩項新功能仍是測試且受方案限制。圖表背後可看查詢是實際控制點；Motion 能否在程式層級穩定編輯，仍是正式使用的未決問題。
anthropic.quote: Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are now in beta. Docs, Slides, and Design are out of beta and on every Claude plan, including Free.
anthropic.quote_zh: Claude Dashboards 與 Claude Motion 現已進入測試。Docs、Slides 與 Design 已結束測試，並在包含 Free 的所有 Claude 方案提供。

google.title_en: Google Cloud launches the Gemini agent as a universal agent for work
google.title_zh: Google Cloud 推出 Gemini agent，定位為工作用通用代理
google.summary_en: At Gemini at Work 2026 on Oct 8, Google Cloud announced the Gemini agent, a single prompt-window agent for questions, knowledge work, media, and code. Google said it plans the work, picks a model, uses skills and tools, and connects to customer systems, with enterprise cost and admin controls. A companion post said it can orchestrate Gemini models and Claude today, with other private and open models later.
google.summary_zh: 10 月 8 日 Gemini at Work 2026，Google Cloud 宣布 Gemini agent：單一提示視窗處理問答、知識工作、媒體與程式。官方說它會規劃工作、選擇模型、使用技能與工具，並連到客戶既有系統，附企業成本與管理控制。配套文章稱目前可編排 Gemini 與 Claude，之後再接其他私有與開源模型。
google.analysis_en: This is a product-layer bet that routing, memory, and enterprise controls matter more than any one model. Availability and which systems are live at launch remain open: the official posts describe the agent, not a completed public rollout metric.
google.analysis_zh: 這是產品層押注：路由、記憶與企業控制比單一模型更關鍵。上線範圍與哪些系統已實際接通仍未交代，官方描述的是代理能力，不是完成度數字。
google.quote: Today at Gemini at Work 2026, Google Cloud announced the Gemini agent, a universal agent for work.
google.quote_zh: 今天在 Gemini at Work 2026，Google Cloud 宣布 Gemini agent，一個用於工作的通用代理。

brief_en: No new flagship model in the window. Google Cloud launched the Gemini agent; Anthropic pledged $150 million to the Genesis Mission and opened a Cyber Mission; OpenAI expanded GPT-6 Intelligent UI and Sol Ultrafast. Press reports put September annualized revenue near $50 billion, below a $70 billion figure.
brief_zh: 無新旗艦模型。Google 推 Gemini agent；Anthropic 承諾 1.5 億並啟網路任務；OpenAI 擴 GPT-6 介面與 Ultrafast，年化營收被指近 500 億。
